scope.review: All registered generators and curated text/word-bank source content reviewed; representative browser lessons tested. Generated variations were sampled, not exhaustively enumerated.

corrections.detail: Adjective/adverb topics no longer match the verb handler; related soft/softly pair corrected.
Connecting-word questions state the intended relationship, verb prompts specify present tense, ongoing forms use correct spellings, and pronoun examples state plural antecedents.
Statement dialogue uses a comma before the speaker tag; sentence-ending distractors avoid a second valid exclamation interpretation.
Middle-vowel contrast uses hot/pot/top instead of dialect-sensitive hot/dog; syllable prompts ask for counts rather than claiming to split the word.

Two Grade 1 motivations are explicit in the text; puddle evaporation is supported by an explicit explanation; towel distractor now contradicts equal spoonfuls rather than asserting different total volumes.
Thirty manually selected phrase models replace arbitrary word-count splits.
Area/perimeter expressions have one correct value; equal-group representation specifies a multiplication equation; fraction correction gives both compared amounts.
Composition states that matching right triangles have two equal short sides. Shape classification asks for the most specific name and explains the square/rectangle/rhombus relationship.
Counting can reach stated endpoints, first-grade survey totals remain within twenty, scaled graph prompts count represented votes, and Grade 3 volume uses liters consistent with 3.MD.A.2.
Comparison stories cannot give Theo two different quantities by choosing Theo as both participants.
Area and square-array lessons use square tiles; perimeter shape proportions follow side lengths; simple mats describe rectangles; model labels join text without inserted commas.

New attempts carry compact content identity. Repeated content across sessions remains practice; duplicate check evidence cannot create mastery; Retained requires at least four fresh checks at 80 percent on a later day at least 24 hours after older successful evidence.

automatedChecks.additionalChecks: Independent equation solutions, expression-choice uniqueness, clock intervals, fraction ordering, endpoints, grade ranges, spelling/word references, syllables, sound matches, phrase models, diagram proportions, simple mats, narration and progress evidence.

languageReference.note: Dictionary matching does not validate browser or ElevenLabs pronunciation, grade placement, or decodability.

remainingLimits: No elementary educator has approved all content or the standards map. Many original activities still have no granular standards metadata.

Full standards coverage is not established. Examples needing more coverage include Grade 3 fractional measurement line plots, explicit multiplication properties/zero facts, kilograms, and stronger Grade 1 phoneme segmentation and two-syllable decoding.
Small word/question banks and fixed text tasks limit assessment depth. Larger separate teaching and check banks are needed so practiced items do not exhaust fresh checks.
Curated texts are original, but are not a verified controlled-decodable sequence tied to individual learned patterns.
There is no validated oral-reading assessment or speech input. Browser speech-engine events are evidence of playback progression, not physical-speaker or pronunciation quality.
Many lesson actions remain multiple-choice or tiles; full interactive measuring/building and misconception-specific animated coaching remain expansion work.
Real-child usability, learning outcomes, real-device Safari, assistive technology and low-end-device performance remain unverified.

recommendations.name: Educator review and standards coverage map
recommendations.add: A teacher review queue and per-grade standards checklist with approved texts, answer keys and remaining gaps.

recommendations.name: Placement and adaptive learning paths
recommendations.add: A short starting assessment and concept-level paths that choose suitable difficulty separately for math and reading.

recommendations.name: Mistake-specific tutor coaching
recommendations.add: Recognize common misconceptions, show a matching short worked example and follow with a fresh transfer problem.

recommendations.name: Reviewed voice and phoneme clips
recommendations.add: A consistent Theo voice, educator-reviewed isolated sounds and accurate phonics pronunciations with replay and slower playback.

recommendations.name: Controlled-decodable book library
recommendations.add: Books linked to already-taught spellings, growing in difficulty with vocabulary and meaningful comprehension work.

recommendations.name: Hands-on story missions
recommendations.add: Drag to regroup tens, tile real areas, share equal groups, set clock hands, measure objects and spend coins in Theo quests; reward learning effort.

recommendations.name: Opt-in read-aloud practice
recommendations.add: Parent-controlled speech practice with careful, confidence-aware feedback and a repeat option; validate it with children before using it for assessment.

recommendations.name: Writing and dictation studio
recommendations.add: Type or write words and sentences from spoken prompts, then get feedback on spelling, capitals, punctuation and word order.

recommendations.name: Personalized daily plan and fresh check banks
recommendations.add: Short daily sequences, spaced retrieval, larger separate teaching/practice/assessment banks and new transfer questions.

recommendations.name: Parent progress and cloud continuity
recommendations.add: Reliable parent accounts and cross-device progress with reports showing supported work, independent evidence, retained skills and the next useful home activity.
